translation.name: Luda yã takada kũ Bisã yão

content: Yenibɑn biru, Dɑfidi u Filisitibɑ kɑmiɑ, u bu sekuru doke. Mɑ u Gɑti kɑ yen bɑru kpɑɑnu mwɑ.
Mɑ u Mɔɑbubɑ kɑmiɑ bɑ kuɑ win yobu. Mɑ bɑ nùn wɔ̃ɔ gobi kɔsiɑmɔ.
Yen biru u Hɑdɑdesɛɛ, Sobɑn sinɑ boko kɑmiɑ Hɑmɑtin berɑ giɑ, sɑnɑm mɛ wi, Hɑdɑdesɛɛ u dɔɔ u win tem yɑsiɑsiɑ dɑɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ Efɑrɑtiɔ.

Mɑ Dɑfidi u nùn tɑbu kɛkɛ nɔrɔbu (1.000) mwɑɑri ye dumi gɑwe, kɑ mɑɑsɔbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbɑ yiru (7.000), kɑ nɑɑnɑɑkobu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu (20.000). Mɑ u ben dumi kpuron nɑɑ sĩinu bɔɔrɑ mɑ n kun mɔ wunɔbu (100) yi u tii deriɑ.
Sirigii be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ Dɑmɑsiɔ bɑ nɑ bu kɑ Hɑdɑdesɛɛ, Sobɑn sinɑ boko somi. Mɑ Dɑfidi u ben tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndɑ yiru (22.000) go.
Mɑ u bu kpɑrobu yiiyɑ. Mɑ Sirigii be, bɑ kuɑ win yobu, bɑ nùn wɔ̃ɔ gobi kɔsiɑmɔ. Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ n Dɑfidi kɔ̃suwɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro mi u dɑ.
Mɑ u Hɑdɑdesɛɛn sɔm kowobun tɛrɛnu mwɛɛrɑ ni bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ. Mɑ u kɑ nu nɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
U mɑɑ sii gɑndu gurɑmɑ tɑ kpɑ̃ Tibusɑti kɑ Kunun di. Wusu yiru ye, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Hɑdɑdesɛɛgisu. Sii gɑn teyɑ Sɑlomɔɔ u kɑ boo kuɑ kɑ gen yɔ̃rɑtii kɑ mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun dendi yɑ̃nu.
Ye Tohu, Hɑmɑtin sinɑ boko u nuɑ mɑ Dɑfidi u Hɑdɑdesɛɛ, Sobɑn sinɑ boko kɑ win tɑbu kowobu kɑmiɑ,

yerɑ u win bii Hɑdorɑmu gɔrɑ Dɑfidin mi u nùn tɔbiri kpɑ u nùn siɑrɑ yèn sɔ̃ u Hɑdɑdesɛɛ tɑbu wɔri u kɑmiɑ. Domi Tohu u rɑɑ kɑ Hɑdɑdesɛɛ tɑbu mɔ̀wɑ. Mɑ u Dɑfidi gbɛ̃ɑ mɔrisiɑ bwese bwesekɑ ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ wurɑ kɑ sii geesu kɑ mɑɑ sii gɑndu.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u ye kpuro yi Yinni Gusunɔn sɔ̃, kɑ mɑɑ sii geesu, kɑ wurɑ ye u mwɛɛrɑ bwese tuku ninin min di. Niyɑ, Edɔmubɑ kɑ Mɔɑbubɑ kɑ Amɔnibɑ kɑ Filisitibɑ kɑ sere Amɑlɛkibɑ.
Abisɑi, Seruyɑn bii, u Edɔmubɑ kɑmiɑ wɔwɑɔ ye bɑ mɔ̀ Bɔru. Mɑ u ben nɔrɔbun subɑ yɛndu yiru sɑri (18.000) go.
Mɑ u kpɑrobu yi yi Edɔmu mi. Mɑ Edɔmu be kpuro bɑ kuɑ Dɑfidin yobu. Yinni Gusunɔ u rɑ n Dɑfidi kɔ̃suwɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro mi u dɑ.
Dɑfidin sɔm kowobun yĩsɑ
Dɑfidi u bɑndu di Isirelibɑ kpuro sɔɔ. Mɑ u geɑ mɔ̀, u bu siriɑmmɛ dee dee.
Yoɑbu, Seruyɑn biiwɑ u tɑbu kowobu kpɑre. Mɑ Yosɑfɑti, Ahiludun bii u sɑ̃ɑ tirenun bero.
Sɑdɔku, Akitubun bii, kɑ Abimɛlɛki, Abiɑtɑɑn biiwɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu. Mɑ Sɑfusɑ u sɑ̃ɑ tire yoro.
Bɛnɑyɑ, Yehoyɑdɑn biiwɑ u sɑ̃ɑ Keretibɑ kɑ Pelɛtibɑn kpɑro. Mɑ Dɑfidin bibu bɑ sɑ̃ɑ win gerunɑsibu.
Bɑ Dɑfidin sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu
sekuru doke
